svg.text: Module · Unified storage (src/persist.ts + src/storage/)
One SQLite file, one WAL writer — the row-level source of truth; kstate JSON is the parallel second source (pain point 1)
Write side (who writes)
src/storage/ingest.ts — unified-view batch writes
stable absolute seq · content-hash ids (identityOfStoredContent)
boundary frame boundaryMsgId lands with the batch
src/persist.ts — session persistence (StateStore)
session file save/load · EPERM alert layer persist-eperm
kernel/ — compression-state writes
blocks / refs / dead_refs / checkpoints
(kernel ships the StateStore interface; host swaps the impl)
kstate JSON — hydration field list (parallel source of truth)
surviving CompressionState fields serialized via mergeState()
dual-channel read/write with the tables — the fork point the evolution would remove
Unified SQLite · schema v11 (#5539 FK sub-index)
PF four tables (#5855 open, layers on after merge): pf_rows / pf_log / pf_ckpt / render face
single file, single WAL writer · migrations = versioned DDL (CREATE IF NOT EXISTS, additive)
optional at-rest encoding: AES-256-GCM (#708) + zstd (#1080); the mysql dialect is a test mirror (src/storage/mysql.ts)
integrity: checkpoint frame signatures + S4 per-row checksums (verdicts trust the chain, never content similarity)
Read side (who reads)
Hydration — src/state-hydration.ts mergeState()
single source for surviving fields (tables + kstate assembled)
Egress — fold-reconcile / snapshot-render (#3756)
fold-coverage check + server-side canonical render (any desync falls back to legacy for the whole turn)
Billing & cache ledger — cache-ledger / billing
per-round token/USD accounting · CCR content retrieval store.ts
Display & export — sessions-data / acp_status / export
web panel session tree · status surface · session export (honest output #155)
Maintenance — state-gc / storage-maintenance / orphan-gc
orphan-block GC · storage GC (sessions.gc.*, opt-in) · dead-ref reclaim
Hard invariants (read AGENTS.md before touching this)
· message ids are never reused (kernel contract): messages.msgId is the bili/kernel canonical id — the host msgid still has no landing spot (pain point 2; #5842 only covers in-flight)
· stable absolute seq (#421 fix): row order is the primary identity carrier; folding = an inactive mark, never a physical delete (GC purges by cover-block lifecycle)
· upgrades are purely additive: schema version only moves forward, old DBs land via CREATE IF NOT EXISTS — any breaking migration needs a rollback drill first (T1 discipline)
dual channel

Key entries: src/storage/schema.ts (the single DDL source of truth) · src/storage/store.ts (row read/write) · src/storage/ingest.ts (batch entry) · src/persist.ts (StateStore wrapper) · src/state-hydration.ts (field list)
